extracted.intended_audience: readers of early-18th-century periodicals (general literate public); scholars of Steele/Addison
extracted.subtask_description: Reprinted issues/essays from Richard Steele's periodical (The Tatler/Spectator), containing satirical essays, letters, and commentary on manners, duelling, manners of the beau/rake, and news of the day. Intended as literary/social commentary rather than procedural guidance.
